gloss: detention center; internment camp; concentration camp

definitions.gloss: detention center; internment camp; concentration camp
definitions.explanation: A facility where people are confined, either for detention, internment, or imprisonment. Can refer to various types of facilities from refugee camps to wartime concentration camps.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦時中|せんじちゅう}→戦時中：28629_senjichuu⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{収容所|しゅうようじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}られた→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: During the war, many people were sent to internment camps.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難民|なんみん}→難民：05313_nanmin⟧{収容所|しゅうようじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Improvements to conditions in refugee camps are being called for.

examples.japanese: {強制収容所|きょうせいしゅうようじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡地|あとち}→跡地：14281_atochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The site of the former concentration camp has been preserved as a museum.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{収容|しゅうよう}→収容：11800_shuuyou⟧ ('accommodation, detention, housing') and {所|じょ} ('place'). The word itself is neutral — the nature of the facility depends on context. It can range from a refugee processing center to a wartime concentration camp.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強制収容所|きょうせいしゅうようじょ}: concentration camp, forced internment camp
- ⟦{難民|なんみん}→難民：05313_nanmin⟧{収容所|しゅうようじょ}: refugee camp
- ⟦{捕虜|ほりょ}→捕虜：20662_horyo⟧{収容所|しゅうようじょ}: prisoner-of-war camp
- {入管|にゅうかん}{収容所|しゅうようじょ}: immigration detention center
- {収容所|しゅうようじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}られる→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to be sent to a camp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{刑務所|けいむしょ}→刑務所：19074_keimusho⟧: prison — for convicted criminals serving sentences
- ⟦{拘置所|こうちしょ}→拘置所：30455_kouchisho⟧: detention house — for suspects awaiting trial
- ⟦{難民|なんみん}→難民：05313_nanmin⟧⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧: refugee camp — the loanword-based alternative
